metaDescription: Mcars is a family business from Roeselare: father and son, 8 regular drivers and 9 car transporters of our own. Discover our story since 2004, our fleet and how we work.

milestones.title: The first load
milestones.body: Filip Maertens loads his first cars. The start of more than twenty years of experience in car transport.

milestones.title: Mcars is founded
milestones.body: From Roeselare, the company gets its name. The approach stays the same: short lines of communication and agreements that hold.

milestones.title: The second generation
milestones.body: Son Ralph joins the business. Father and son continue building together.

milestones.title: A visit to Wörth
milestones.body: Together with transporters from the region, we visit the Mercedes-Benz truck factory in Germany, where our Actros trucks are built.

milestones.title: Nine transporters, eight drivers
milestones.body: Every week across France, and further from Scandinavia to Spain. Still with the same family behind the wheel.

why.title: Personal & family-run
why.body: No call centre, no numbers. You speak directly to the team that actually transports your car.

why.title: Reliable & insured
why.body: Every trip with a CMR consignment note and insured transport. Clear agreements, properly kept.

why.title: Spontaneous, keep it simple
why.body: Quick to respond, no fuss. You request, and within 24 hours you get a clear answer with a price and schedule.

why.title: Transparent
why.body: You always know where you stand. No hidden costs, no surprises along the way.

insured.b: Every vehicle is covered for the entire journey.
Confirms the collection and records the condition at departure.
Photos as evidence in the event of damage — carefully and discreetly stored.

hero.title:
We have been loading cars since 2004.

As Mcars since 2009.
hero.subtitle: A family business from Roeselare: father and son, eight regular drivers and nine car transporters of our own.

who.text: A family business that knows car transport inside out. No call centre, no middlemen: you speak to the people who actually transport your car.
who.muted: Drive with Mcars once, and you stay.

duo.alt: Two generations of Mcars between two car transporters
duo.title: Two generations, <muted>one way of working.</muted>
duo.filipBody: Loaded his first cars in 2004 and founded Mcars in 2009. Almost twenty years later, he is still out among the trucks himself.
duo.ralphBody: Joined the business and is building the coming years of Mcars, with the same short lines of communication as his father.
duo.draft: Role and start year still to be confirmed

fleet.label: The fleet
fleet.title: Nine transporters of our own, <muted>eight regular drivers.</muted>

material.title: We drive with <muted>the best equipment.</muted>
material.body: Your car deserves a truck that we ourselves trust. That is why we drive Mercedes Actros and Scania, each with a Kässbohrer body and a winch on board.
material.visitBody: In 2026, together with transporters from the region, we visited the Mercedes-Benz truck factory in Wörth. That way we see for ourselves where our Actros trucks are built and what is coming next.
